summary.text: Cinzia Lettieri is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Chris Aniskovich.

paragraphs.text: Lettieri ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost to Aniskovich, 50.5 percent to 49.5 percent (7,252 votes to 7,102).
Ballotpedia lists an endorsement from the Connecticut AFL-CIO for her 2026 campaign.
